wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the IB PYP Games project overview and getting started guide. # IB PYP Games: Comprehensive Educational Gaming Platform

## Project Introduction

IB PYP Games is a comprehensive educational gaming platform designed for International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (IB PYP) students. The project creates interactive, curriculum-aligned learning games that support transdisciplinary learning across multiple subjects and grade levels.

### Purpose Statement
The platform transforms traditional IB PYP curriculum into engaging, hands-on digital experiences that help young learners explore concepts through play while maintaining strong alignment with official learning objectives and assessment criteria.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Curriculum Alignment**: Each game directly supports specific IB PYP Units of Inquiry (UOI) and subject learning outcomes
- **Multi-Subject Integration**: Games span literacy, mathematics, science, Chinese language, and UOI themes
- **Age-Appropriate Design**: Content tailored for grades 1-5 with progressive complexity
- **Accessibility**: Mobile-first design optimized for iPad landscape mode and desktop use
- **Stand-alone Deployment**: Self-contained HTML5 applications requiring no server infrastructure

### Target Audience
- **Primary Students**: Grades 1-5 in IB PYP international schools
- **Educators**: Teachers seeking supplemental digital resources aligned with curriculum
- **Parents**: Families supporting home learning during holidays or extended absences
- **Schools**: Institutions implementing IB PYP curriculum who need scalable digital content

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a modular, curriculum-driven architecture built around static HTML5 games with sophisticated build tooling and dynamic content generation.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Curriculum Map JSON] --> B[Index Generator Script]
    B --> C[Generated Hub Interface]
    C --> D[Individual Game Pages]
    
    E[Build System Vite] --> F[Static Asset Processing]
    E --> G[Multi-Page Build]
    E --> H[Asset Copying]
    
    I[Game Categories] --> J[Literacy Games]
    I --> K[Math Games]
    I --> L[Science Games]
    I --> M[Chinese Games]
    I --> N[UOI Games]
    
    O[Advanced Features] --> P[Gesture Control]
    O --> Q[3D Graphics Three.js]
    O --> R[Phaser 3D Engine]
    O --> S[MediaPipe AI]
    
    D --> J
    D --> K
    D --> L
    D --> M
    D --> N
    
    P --> S
    Q --> R
```

### Component Breakdown

**Core Architecture Layers:**
- **Data Layer**: Centralized curriculum mapping in JSON format drives all UI generation
- **Build Layer**: Custom Vite configuration handles multi-page builds and asset management  
- **Presentation Layer**: Generated hub interface provides navigation to individual games
- **Game Layer**: Standalone HTML5 applications with self-contained logic and assets

**Design Patterns:**
- **Configuration-Driven UI**: Curriculum map JSON generates entire hub interface dynamically
- **Modular Game Architecture**: Each game operates as independent module with clear boundaries
- **Plugin-Based Scene System**: Advanced games use scene registration pattern for extensibility
- **Event-Driven Communication**: Inter-module communication via custom event systems

### System Relationships

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Curriculum Data] --> B[Index Generator]
    B --> C[Hub Interface]
    C --> D[Game Router]
    
    E[Build Scripts] --> F[Asset Pipeline]
    F --> G[Production Build]
    
    H[Game Modules] --> I[Shared Utilities]
    H --> J[External Libraries]
    
    K[Service Worker] --> L[PWA Capabilities]
    L --> M[Offline Support]
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Primary Hub Interface**: `src/index.html` - Dynamically generated curriculum navigation system
**Build Configuration**: `vite.config.js` - Multi-page build system with custom asset processing
**Package Management**: `package.json` - Modern ES modules with Vite development workflow

### Core Modules

**Curriculum Data Structure**: `src/data/curriculum-map.json` - Central source of truth for all educational content
**Index Generation**: `scripts/generate-index.js` - Dynamic HTML generation from curriculum data
**Service Worker**: `src/sw.js` - Progressive Web App capabilities for offline access

### Advanced Game Implementations

**Gesture-Controlled Spelling Game**: `src/literacy/movespelling/` - MediaPipe hand tracking with Phaser 3D engine
**3D Cosmos Explorer**: `src/science/gesture-cosmos/` - Three.js scenes with gesture-based camera control
**Word Search & Crossword**: `src/literacy/wordquest/` - Modular word puzzle generator with voice support

### Configuration Approach

**Build Configuration**: `vite.config.js` - Custom plugin system for asset copying and multi-page builds
**Development Workflow**: npm scripts automate index generation, quality assurance, and production builds
**PWA Manifest**: `src/manifest.json` - Progressive web app configuration for mobile installation

### External Dependencies

**Core Frameworks**:
- **Vite 5.x**: Modern build tool with hot module replacement
- **Three.js 0.163.0**: 3D graphics rendering for advanced science visualizations
- **Phaser 3.60.0**: Game engine for interactive spelling and puzzle games
- **MediaPipe Hands**: AI-powered hand gesture recognition for touchless interaction

**Development Tools**:
- **JavaScript Obfuscator**: Code protection for production builds
- **Vite Minify Plugin**: Enhanced compression and optimization
- **Terser**: JavaScript minification with console preservation for debugging

### Integration Points

**Curriculum Mapping**: JSON-driven architecture allows easy addition of new units and games
**Asset Pipeline**: Automatic copying of game-specific CSS, JS, and media files
**Service Worker Integration**: Precaching strategy for offline gameplay experience
**Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with landscape optimization for tablets

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Curriculum JSON] --> B[Build Process]
    B --> C[Generated HTML]
    C --> D[Game Navigation]
    
    E[Game Assets] --> F[Asset Pipeline]
    F --> G[Distribution]
    
    H[External Libraries] --> I[CDN Loading]
    I --> J[Game Runtime]
    
    K[Service Worker] --> L[Cache Strategy]
    L --> M[Offline Access]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Multi-Grade Curriculum Support**: Organized by IB PYP units with cross-subject integration
**Interactive Learning Games**: Over 20+ unique educational games spanning literacy, math, science, and language
**Gesture Recognition**: Advanced hand-tracking technology for immersive, touchless interaction
**3D Visualization**: Complex scientific concepts rendered in interactive three-dimensional space
**Progressive Enhancement**: Works on basic devices while providing enhanced experiences on capable hardware

### Implementation Highlights

**Dynamic Curriculum Hub**: `scripts/generate-index.js` - Automatically generates navigation from structured data
**Scene-Based Architecture**: `src/science/gesture-cosmos/core/scene-host.js` - Pluggable 3D scene management
**Hand Tracking Integration**: `src/literacy/movespelling/js/core/hand-tracker.js` - Real-time gesture recognition
**Voice Control System**: `src/literacy/wordquest/js/voice-control.js` - Speech synthesis for accessibility

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CurriculumHub
    CurriculumHub --> GameSelection
    GameSelection --> GameLoading
    GameLoading --> ActiveGame
    ActiveGame --> GameComplete
    GameComplete --> GameSelection
    GameSelection --> CurriculumHub
    
    state ActiveGame {
        [*] --> Initialization
        Initialization --> GestureDetection
        GestureDetection --> GameLogic
        GameLogic --> Feedback
        Feedback --> GestureDetection
    }
    
    state GestureDetection {
        [*] --> CameraAccess
        CameraAccess --> HandTracking
        HandTracking --> CommandProcessing
        CommandProcessing --> [*]
    }
```

**Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Optimized for iPad landscape mode while maintaining desktop functionality
**Offline Capability**: Service worker caching enables gameplay without internet connection
**Accessibility Features**: Voice control, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support
**Performance Optimization**: Lazy loading of 3D scenes and efficient asset management

The IB PYP Games platform represents a sophisticated approach to educational technology, combining modern web technologies with pedagogical best practices to create engaging, curriculum-aligned learning experiences that scale across multiple grade levels and subjects.

---

- [gesture cosmos main.js](src/science/gesture-cosmos/main.js)
- [curriculum-map.json](src/data/curriculum-map.json)
- [wordquest/index.html](src/literacy/wordquest/index.html)

</blog>
